items.rationale: Sorted, the values are 11, 12, 14, 15 and 90. With five values the median is the third one, which is 14, so the 90 does not move it.
Sorted, the values are 100, 120, 130 and 900. With an even count the median is the mean of the two middle values: (120 + 130) / 2 = 125.
The median looks at the middle week, so one unusual order barely moves it. The average counts the bulk order in full and overstates a normal week.
The average adds every value, so a bigger outlier raises it. The median only depends on the middle values, and the biggest value is still the biggest after the change, so the median stays put.
